headline: New Zealand Inflation Hits 3.7% Ahead of Central Bank Meeting
summary: Inflation in New Zealand came in at 3.7%, below forecasts but still elevated ahead of the Reserve Bank's interest rate decision.
why: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand adjusts its official cash rate to target inflation between 1% and 3%, directly influencing borrowing costs.

impacts.name: New Zealand Dollar
impacts.why: Lower-than-expected inflation may reduce pressure on policymakers to keep raising interest rates.
